spans.s:
goṣṭhī (EI 24; SII 3; BL), an assembly; a corporate body; cf. Tamil goṣṭhiśeydān̤, convener of a pariṣad. []
 (LL), Buddhist; a committee; cf. Bauddha-goṣṭhī, Goṣthī-śramaṇa.
Goṣṭhika (EI 4, 24, 33; CII 4), member of a committee or assembly; member of a managing committee; member of a committee like that of the trustees.
